objects.comment: Every bulletin, whichever way it arrived: the TA's bulletin-board poll (pull) or the SiteToSiteBulletinReportingTask (push). Panels query this object, never a child.
Data in and out of the whole flow, normalised to one set of names: the Reporting Task's 5-minute counters on the push path, the root process group's flow metrics on the pull path.
One row per component status snapshot. The TA writes flat events (nifi:api:*_status); the push flow still sends the nested status history (nifi:api:*_history), read here from its latest snapshot.
The logback-format logs. nifi:log:request is excluded: it is NCSA combined and has its own object.
One event per Prometheus sample, flattened by the TA.
The NiFi version the TA detected, one event per polling cycle.
NCSA combined access log for the API and UI. Fields come from Splunk's core access-extractions.
